plan.question: Why is Purnia lower than Nalanda in training completion and 6-month employment, and what intervention should be done?

insights.message: This file contains only aggregate counts (enrolled, completed, employed) by district and year. It has no information about programme design, funding, staffing, infrastructure, participant characteristics, or any other factor that could explain why one district outperforms another. No causal explanation or specific intervention recommendation can be drawn from this data alone.

view.title: Purnia vs Nalanda: Training Completion and 6-Month Employment by Year
view.note: The chart shows the two rates for Purnia and Nalanda across 2022 and 2023. The insights above state the 2023 gap in percentage points. This file alone cannot explain why one district performs differently from another, so no intervention can be recommended without guessing.

interpretation_guard.caveat: This data is a synthetic fixture and does not represent real programme outcomes. No causal claims can be made from it. Even with real data, this file alone lacks the explanatory variables (e.g., programme type, funding, trainer-to-participant ratio, local economic conditions) needed to explain why one district performs differently from another. No intervention can be recommended from this file without guessing.
